q1_issues.issue: The Name string keeps the office premodifier - "President Ronald Reagan" - where an occupational/office premodifier must stay out of the Name string.
The office typing derived from that premodifier is emitted bare; with a past host clause ("served") it should take the host's Past wrapper like any appositive typing.
The whole PP-bearing title is fused into one symbol assistant_secretary_of_energy_for_defense_programs, so "of energy" and "for defense programs" are never emitted as the noun's complement obliques.
That symbol keeps the plural "programs" un-lemmatized, against the rule that every class symbol is lemmatized to its singular base form.
"served" takes Experiencer; holding an office is an activity rather than a postural or psych stative, and the stated default for an unclear intransitive subject is Agent.

q2_gaps: a capacity "as"-phrase ("served as <office>") - whether it types the subject or stays a preposition-named oblique on the event is unaddressed
a multi-word office title combining a rank adjective with stacked PP complements ("assistant secretary of energy for defense programs") used as an article-less predicate nominal
notes: "After his retirement" is handled well - the event-noun anchor gets its class atom and the Before ordering with no tense of its own, and the possessive correctly fills the nominalization's subject role rather than becoming a Possession.
